# #2052: Patch: a card opened from the patch notes shows its loading and retry states instead of nothing
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

On the patch-notes page, clicking a card's name in a "changed in this patch" list opens that card's detail. On a slow connection the click looks dead — nothing appears while the card's data loads — and if the load fails, nothing ever appears and there is no retry. After this patch the click shows a loading state, and a failed load shows the error with a working Try again, the way every other panel on the same page already behaves.

## Why

`OpenedCard` (`apps/web/src/patches/PatchNotes.tsx:331-336`) returns `null` for every non-ready `useLoaded` state. It is the only one of the file's five `useLoaded` consumers that swallows those states: `PatchCardsPanel` (`:195-213`), the top-level `PatchNotes` (`:459-484`) and `CardHistoryBody` (`patches/CardHistory.tsx:58-76`) all render loading, error and retry. The machinery is already there — `useLoaded` exposes `retry()` (`patches/context.tsx:57-64`) and failed loads are evicted so retry can succeed (`source.ts:114-117`). Distinct from issue #2036's listed items (skeletons, undo toasts, command menu, sheet gestures).

## Proposal

Render the file's existing `patch-status`/`patch-retry` pattern inside `OpenedCard` for the `loading` and `error` states.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/patches/PatchNotes.tsx` and its test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A pending card open shows a loading line where the card will appear
- [ ] A failed open shows the error sentence and a Try again that retries
- [ ] A successful open is unchanged

## Size and risks

Small: about twenty lines plus a test, reusing the file's own components.
